name: Maimaimaigoen: Episode 3 - The Divided Children
storyline:
The children have watched their friends fall to devastating Game Overs, one after another. In response, they split into two teams: the "Wolf Team", which is determined to collect medals on their own and escape, and the "Goat Team", which works together to gather medals and try to escape as a group...

Okada Yu works hard to collect medals with the Goat Team. Meanwhile, the Wolf Team, having left the Rest Area, discovers a new attraction called "Merry-Go-Circuit". Okada decides to join them, unwilling to let them face it alone. As Okada's belief in "helping each other to escape together" begins to crumble, various trials await them at Merry-Go-Circuit.
summary: As their friends get Game Overs one after the other, the children split into two teams!? Together with the Wolf Team, who are determined to collect medals on their own, they face Merry-Go-Circuit, where a new "trial" awaits them!
